research_notes: A future long-run utilization estimate should include the probability-weighted cost of failed turns, not simply average successful duration.
Even rare failures can dominate if they lose large uncheckpointed tails or break continuation.
Incremental checkpointing and pre-arm reduce those costs, which may permit a higher safe operational target.
The optimal checkpoint cadence is therefore coupled to failure cost but can be studied after the runtime envelope.
Current dense checkpoints intentionally minimize diagnostic uncertainty.
Final close remains the classification gate.
